CREATE TABLE "public"."Order" (
  "billableKm" int4 NOT NULL,
  "createdAt" timestamptz(3) DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "deliveryAddress" text NOT NULL,
  "deliveryPin" text NOT NULL,
  "distanceKm" float8 NOT NULL,
  "id" text NOT NULL,
  "pickupAddress" text NOT NULL,
  "pickupPin" text NOT NULL,
  "status" text DEFAULT 'PLACED' NOT NULL,
  "totalCharge" int4 NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id"),
  CONSTRAINT "Order_status_check_675c73a1" CHECK ("status" IN ('PLACED', 'ACCEPTED', 'IN_TRANSIT', 'COMPLETED', 'CANCELLED'))
)
